newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka October avg inflation at 15.3 pct - govt.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka October avg inflation at 15.3 pct - govt.

text.p: Sri Lanka's annual average inflation for October increased to 15.3 percent from 14.8 percent the previous month, the Department of Census and Statistics said on Thursday.
The Colombo Consumers Price Index for October rose to 1982.7 from 1974.2 in September, an increase of 8.5 index points or 0.4 percent, the agency said.
The increase was due mainly to an increase in the price of kerosene, it said, adding that prices of bread, milk, tea, lime, eggs, coconuts and vegetables also rose.

Offsetting the rise in those key CCPI market basket items were falls in the prices of rice, dried chillies, coconut oil and fresh and dried fish due to increased supplies of those goods in the capital, the Department said.
